## What this changes
Short summary.

## Contract
- [ ] Follows CONTRACT.md as written, or
- [ ] Updates CONTRACT.md (sections changed: ...)

## Checks
- [ ] `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` pass (Python changes)
- [ ] `mypy` passes (Python changes)
- [ ] `pytest` passes (Python changes)
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run build` pass (dashboard changes)
- [ ] No secrets, payloads, or task ids in logs, metrics labels, or the diff

## Notes for reviewers
Anything subtle: failure windows, retry behavior, exact-vs-approximate values.
